subject: displaying multiple ROC curves on the same graph

messages.author: 73dc135fbed34a7a
messages.subject: displaying multiple ROC curves on the same graph
parts:
Can multiple ROC curves (from different models) be displayed on the same graph ? This did not work for me despite trying on multiple pc's.
I tried to also uncheck the "Advanced Graphics" in setttings. In this case rattle hangs, and the main R console gets this error message:
"Error in as.double(y) :
  cannot coerce type 'S4' to vector of type 'double'"

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: displaying multiple ROC curves on the same graph
parts:
Hi Cornel,

That is now fixed in Version 3.5.5

> install.packages("rattle", repos="http://rattle.togaware.com", type="source")

Thanks for reporting the bug.

Graham Williams
